stable.notes: Meeting answers show evidence confidence. Optional Jev setup no longer keeps Finish setup open; unavailable model details start collapsed. Pairs with server 6.71.5, which lets new saved-meeting questions read accepted finalized passages while preserving earlier answer quotes. Developer ID signed and Apple notarized. With explicit public-topic consent, Meeting Ask can retrieve public claims and cost benchmarks; private transcript details are withheld. Companion 628 exposes this optional setting and remains a private device-test candidate.

whatsNew.summary: Meeting Ask explains evidence confidence, settings stay compact, and optional setup no longer holds the reminder open. Pairs with server 6.71.5.

sections.title: Clearer meeting answers
items: Answers show labeled rows and an evidence-confidence note. Meeting Ask accounts for incomplete G2 transcription and distinguishes corrections, proposals and commitments.
With server 6.71.5, new questions about saved recordings read accepted finalized passages alongside live evidence. Previous answer quotes remain unchanged.
Confirm a meeting domain and calendar match on compatible companion builds to guide COS lookup; calendar details do not prove what was said.

With explicit public-topic consent, server 6.71.5 retrieves the discussed public claim and cost benchmarks, cites sources and explains comparison limits. This optional choice is exposed by private companion 628.

sections.title: Compact settings and setup
items: Meeting assistant settings keep unavailable model details collapsed until you expand them. The model control under live Ask keeps the same setting.
Optional Jev keys no longer keep Finish setup open. You can still configure Jev in the guide.
Includes labeled Meeting Ask answers and the COS-styled What’s New view from 0.5.283.

sections.title: Transcript limits
items: Live words remain preliminary. Timestamp and progressive-refinement canaries stay disabled; this release does not promise improved raw transcription accuracy.
Existing questions, sources, files, model selection and recording remain available. No new glasses sideload is required for the server and Control update.

notice.title: Right-click the pet
notice.body: Right-click the pet for Full motion, Calm motion or No motion, or to hide it. Hidden, it comes back from COS Control in the menu bar, under Session pet. The pet also shows Codex threads while they work and Cursor chats mid-turn.
